name: The Thing That Scares Me Most: Heidegger’s Anti-Semitism and the Return to Zion.
headline: The Thing That Scares Me Most: Heidegger’s Anti-Semitism and the Return to Zion.
description: The article focuses on the aspects of the antisemitism of European philosopher Martin Heidegger and the return to the Zionism, a movement which look towards the creation of the Jewish state in Palestine.
